"C:\\WINDOWS\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe" -Command "@'
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

cmd = [sys.executable, '-m', 'mini_harness', 'run', 'data/input.csv', 'data/events.jsonl', '--output', 'tmp/report.json']
proc = subprocess.run(cmd, text=True, capture_output=True)
assert proc.returncode == 0, proc.stderr
Path('tmp/m3.log').write_text(proc.stderr, encoding='utf-8')
logs = [json.loads(line) for line in proc.stderr.splitlines() if line.strip()]
assert [x['stage'] for x in logs if x['status'] == 'started'] == ['extract', 'clean', 'report']
assert all({'stage', 'status', 'attempt'} <= set(x) for x in logs)
r = json.loads(Path('tmp/report.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert r == {'processed_count': 4, 'rejected_count': 2, 'retry_count': 0, 'source_files': ['data/input.csv', 'data/events.jsonl'], 'report_label': 'default'}

cmd_yaml = [sys.executable, '-m', 'mini_harness', 'run', 'data/input.csv', 'data/events.jsonl', '--output', 'tmp/report-yaml.json', '--config', 'config/m2.yaml']
proc_yaml = subprocess.run(cmd_yaml, text=True, capture_output=True)
assert proc_yaml.returncode == 0, proc_yaml.stderr
ry = json.loads(Path('tmp/report-yaml.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert ry['report_label'] == 'yaml-config'

import mini_harness
from mini_harness.runner import HarnessError, run_dag
ri = run_dag(['data/input.csv', 'data/events.jsonl'], log_stream=None)
assert ri['processed_count'] == 4 and ri['report_label'] == 'default'
print('m3 verified')
